summary: Takes untargeted LC-MS metabolomics from raw mzML to biological interpretation: xcms 4.x feature extraction, QC-based drift correction and normalization (pmp), confidence-stratified metabolite annotation (matchms/MetFrag) with MSI/Schymanski levels, permutation-validated statistics (PCA/OPLS-DA/univariate), and background-aware pathway mapping (MetaboAnalystR/FELLA). Batch/plate design and an alternate MS-DIAL/lipidomics route are included as supporting Skills. Research use only.
